question: Where can aims unattainable through the Vedas be successfully accomplished?
premises: Some aims are not achievable in the Vedas
The same aims are achievable elsewhere
The Śiva Āgama is named as that locus
inference: What cannot be achieved in the Vedas can be well achieved in the Śiva Āgama.
plain_english: What cannot be achieved in the Vedas is well achievable in the Śiva Āgama.
